title: The Hunt for XXE to LFI: How I Uncovered CVE-2019–9670 in a Bug Bounty Program
summary_en: A few months ago, during one of my late-night bug bounty hunting sessions, I stumbled upon a critical vulnerability that could lead to a full server takeover. The target was a well-known program, and I was determined to dig deep.
excerpt: A few months ago, during one of my late-night bug bounty hunting sessions, I stumbled upon a critical vulnerability that could lead to a full server takeover. The target was a well-known program, and I was determined to dig deep. This is the story of how I discovered the XXE to LFI vulnerability (CVE-2019–9670) in my target program. ### The Discovery While probing the target, I noticed something peculiar about the way their server handled XML inputs.
